subject: planner: predicate simplification when to push down predicate with join (#61316)
summary: Adds predicate simplification at the start of `LogicalJoin.PredicatePushDown` to simplify incoming predicates (e.g. `OR` with constants / redundant branches) before join pushdown; updates related golden outputs and adds a join regression test.
